GraceTechnology.Language: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; final stack choices are open
GraceTechnology.Runtime: Static files served by any web host; no server-side runtime. Local build tooling to be selected by the first approved specification.
GraceTechnology.Framework: Undecided; a static-site generator versus hand-authored pages is an open decision for the first specification.
GraceTechnology.TestingStack: To be defined; expected to cover HTML validity, link integrity, accessibility, and rendered-output checks. GRACE lint runs on .grace state.
GraceTechnology.Observability: None for this source repository; the published site's hosting analytics are a deployment decision.

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Use existing host tools; do not require credentials or model inference for build and check.
Generated agent projections under .claude and .agents are replaceable output from dev-pipe, not authority.
